title: BobFlow: Towards Human-Agent Collaborative Data Science Using Dataflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.05761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established human-agent collaboration as a promising paradigm for data science. Effective collaboration requires a shared computational abstraction that enables agents to reason about processing logic while allowing human analysts to understand, guide, and refine the analysis. Although scripts written in Python or SQL provide precise control, their syntax and execution details can be difficult for analysts to understand and modify. In this paper, we argue that dataflows are an effective abstraction for human-agent collaboration in data science. We introduce BobFlow, a system that combines the dataflow abstraction with the ReAct paradigm. It enables agents to iteratively construct and execute dataflows for data science tasks while allowing analysts to inspect the analysis and provide feedback. translated_title: BobFlow：基于数据流的人机智能体协作数据科学
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使人类与智能体协作成为数据科学中一种具有前景的范式。有效的协作需要一个共享的计算抽象，使智能体能够对处理逻辑进行推理，同时让人类分析师能够理解、引导和完善分析。尽管用 Python 或 SQL 编写的脚本提供了精确的控制，但其语法和执行细节对分析师来说可能难以理解和修改。在本文中，我们认为数据流是数据科学中人机智能体协作的一种有效抽象。我们介绍了 BobFlow，一个将数据流抽象与 ReAct 范式相结合的系统。它使智能体能够为数据科学任务迭代地构建和执行数据流，同时允许分析师检查分析过程并提供反馈。我们的用户研究表明，BobFlow 帮助分析师理解、检查和验证智能体生成的分析。
tldr: 提出 BobFlow 系统，将数据流抽象与 ReAct 范式相结合，使智能体能够迭代构建和执行数据流来完成数据科学任务，同时让人类分析师可以直观地检查、引导和验证智能体的分析。
en_tdlr: BobFlow combines the dataflow abstraction with the ReAct paradigm, enabling agents to iteratively construct and execute dataflows for data science tasks while allowing human analysts to inspect, guide, and verify the agent's analysis.
